skill.name: Data Privacy Compliance

skill.summary: Guides privacy compliance workflows for GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, DPIAs, consent, and data subject rights.

content.value_statement: Teams must translate privacy laws into product, policy, and engineering controls. This skill provides structured guidance for rights requests, consent, DPIAs, notices, and breach response.
actual_capabilities: Explains GDPR, CCPA, CPRA, and HIPAA requirements at a practical level.
Outlines workflows for access, deletion, portability, and objection requests.
Provides consent management patterns with granular preference examples.
Supplies privacy by design guidance for minimization, purpose limits, and retention.
Includes DPIA, privacy policy, breach response, and compliance checklist templates.
limitations: It is guidance material and does not replace legal counsel.
It does not automatically audit live systems, repositories, or data stores.
Examples need adaptation for each jurisdiction, industry, and processing activity.
Regulatory obligations can change, so users must verify current legal requirements.

use_cases.title: Plan Product Privacy Controls
use_cases.description: Map product features to consent, minimization, retention, and data subject rights requirements.

use_cases.title: Implement Rights Request Workflows
use_cases.description: Design access, deletion, portability, and objection handling flows with audit records.

use_cases.title: Prepare Compliance Documentation
use_cases.description: Draft DPIA sections, privacy notice content, breach response steps, and regulatory checklists.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Privacy Checklist
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review for a new application.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this product description and create a GDPR, CCPA, and HIPAA privacy checklist. Keep each item action oriented.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Rights Request Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a data subject access and deletion request workflow for this service. Include verification, timelines, exceptions, and audit records.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Consent Controls
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this consent experience for GDPR and CCPA concerns. Identify missing choices, unclear language, and withdrawal requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Run a DPIA Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the DPIA framework to assess this processing activity. Cover necessity, proportionality, risks, safeguards, and open legal questions.

output_examples.input: A team asks how to handle a user deletion request for an ecommerce account.
output: Check tax, fraud, and contract retention duties.
Delete or anonymize data across core systems and vendors.
Record the decision, timeline, and confirmation message.

output_examples.input: A product team needs a consent banner review.
output: Separate essential, analytics, and marketing choices.
Delay tracking until consent is granted.
Provide a clear withdrawal path in account settings.

output_examples.input: A privacy officer needs DPIA planning notes for a profiling feature.
output: Document the processing purpose and affected data subjects.
Assess whether profiling is necessary for the stated goal.
Rate risks to rights and freedoms.
Define safeguards such as access controls, minimization, and review gates.

best_practices: Start with data inventory, purpose, lawful basis, retention, and sharing details.
Verify regulatory timelines and thresholds before using generated guidance in production.
Pair each privacy requirement with an owner, control, evidence source, and review date.
anti_patterns: Do not treat template text as final legal advice.
Do not collect extra personal data because a future use might appear later.
Do not load analytics or marketing trackers before valid consent is recorded.

faq.question: Does this skill provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It provides practical compliance guidance that should be reviewed by qualified counsel.

faq.question: Which privacy laws does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers GDPR, CCPA, CPRA, HIPAA, and general international privacy principles.

faq.question: Can it create a DPIA?
faq.answer: It can structure a DPIA and identify key risks, safeguards, and open questions.

faq.question: Can it review consent flows?
faq.answer: Yes. It can check consent choices, withdrawal paths, and tracking timing against common requirements.

faq.question: Does it scan production systems?
faq.answer: No. It only provides guidance based on information supplied in the prompt.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: Product, engineering, legal, security, and compliance teams can use it for privacy planning.
